notablePrerequisites: You control at least six basic Forests and/or basic Snow Covered Forests.
description:
Activate any basic Forest or Snow-Covered Forest you control by tapping it, adding {G}.
Sasaya's Essence triggers, causing you to add at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Wakeroot Elemental by paying {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}, untapping a basic Forest or Snow-Covered Forest and causing it to become a 5/5 Elemental creature with haste that's still a land until end of turn.
Repeat.
